Theme

Computing & programming

mute verb and adjective

a phone or a sound

also muted, silent mode, put on silent, unmute

our formation

sonum exstinguō, exstinguere, exstīnxī, exstīnctum

put out the sound: mute

Our phrase: no reference work has a word for muting. A sound is switched off as a light is (see switch off, turn off): exstinguere, with sonus as for volume. To unmute, sonum excitāre (see switch on).

Other words

  • mūtus, mūta, mūtum — muted, on silent

    also used · our formation · Plaut. Trin. 4.2.163, of a bell that gives no sound (Lewis & Short s.v. mūtus)

    Of a phone on silent: tēlephōnum mūtum.

Examples

  • Exstingue sonum, quaesō.

    Mute it, please.composed

See also volume, switch off, telephone.

SourcesLewis & Short: exstinguo · Lewis & Short: mutus
